products.name: Dyno Extreme Slim
products.tagline: Ultra-strong. Natural tobacco. Built for experienced adults.
products.description: Take intensity to the next level with Dyno Extreme Slim. Made for experienced users, this ultra-strong pouch combines a natural tobacco flavour with a powerful nicotine hit, delivering a bold, long-lasting experience for adult consumers seeking maximum strength. Soft pouches, spit-free and easy to use.
products.flavour: Signature mint with a smooth, cool natural tobacco profile
products.format: Slim white pouch for a comfortable, discreet fit
features: Soft mesh pouch technology for consistent release
Canadian plain packaging, resealable 50 g pack
Discreet placement for modern indoor restrictions

products.name: Dyno Blast Slim
products.tagline: Light cooling. Fast-release nicotine. Soft white pouches.
products.description: Dyno Blast Slims deliver a light cooling experience with a high, fast-releasing dose of nicotine. Soft white pouches, spit-free and easy to use — a strong value option for adult consumers who want cooling refreshment with reliable strength.
products.flavour: Light cooling white-pouch flavour with smooth, intense nicotine satisfaction
products.format: Slim blast pouch for discreet comfort
features: Soft all-white mesh pouches for consistent release
Triple-layer aluminum pouch for ultimate freshness
Canadian plain packaging, resealable 50 g pack
